description: This file defines the MockSSPILibrary class used for unit testing SSPI library calls on Windows, including methods for handling security credentials, security contexts, and expectations for package info queries.

classes.name: MockSSPILibrary
classes.description: A mock implementation of SSPILibrary for unit testing, allowing expectations to be set for security package info queries and managing internal state for credentials and contexts.

methods.name: MockSSPILibrary
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the mock library with a specified package.

methods.name: ExpectQuerySecurityPackageInfo
methods.description: Sets an expectation for a QuerySecurityPackageInfo call with specified response code and package info.
